questions.subject: english
questions.question: 'I Have a Dream' is a celebrated speech delivered by ..........
questions.explanation: Yeh aitihasik bhashan Martin Luther King, Jr. dwara 28 August 1963 ko diya gaya tha.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: 'And as we walk, we make the pledge that we shall ..........'
questions.explanation: Bhashan mein kavi kehte hain ki chalte huye hum sankalp lete hain ki hum hamesha aage badhenge aur kabhi peechhe nahi hatenge.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: Who fought tirelessly for the civil rights of Negroes and people living in ghettos?
questions.explanation: Martin Luther King, Jr. ne America mein ashweton aur bastiyon mein rehne wale logon ke nagrik adhikaaron ke liye ladaai ladi.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: Martin Luther King, Jr. delivered his speech from the steps of the .......... in Washington, D.C.
questions.explanation: Unhone Washington D.C. mein Lincoln Memorial ki seedhiyon par khade hokar yeh bhashan diya tha.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: In 1964, Martin Luther King, Jr. became the youngest person to receive the ..........
questions.explanation: Saal 1964 mein matra 35 saal ki aayu mein unhe Nobel Shanti Puraskar mila aur weh yeh samman paane wale sabse kam umra ke vyakti bane.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: According to the speech, the bank of justice for the Negro people is ..........
questions.explanation: King kehte hain ki hum yeh manne se inkar karte hain ki nyay ka bank diwaliya (bankrupt) ho gaya hai.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: Martin Luther King, Jr. received the Nobel Prize in which category?
questions.explanation: Unhin nasliya bhedbhav ke khilaf ahinsak andolan ke liye Nobel Peace Prize (Shanti Puraskar) diya gaya tha.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: President Abraham Lincoln signed the .......... for the freedom of American slaves.
questions.explanation: Abraham Lincoln ne 1 January 1863 ko Emancipation Proclamation par hastakshar kiye the jisse daason ko mukti mili.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: Martin Luther King, Jr. strongly disliked .......... discrimination.
questions.explanation: Martin Luther King, Jr. ne aajiwan rangbhed aur nasliya bhedbhav (racial discrimination) ka virodh kiya.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: Abraham Lincoln is historically famous for his decisive struggle against ..........
questions.explanation: Abraham Lincoln ne America mein das-pratha (slavery) ke un moolan ke liye aitihasik kadam uthaye the.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: On which date did Martin Luther King, Jr. deliver his memorable speech 'I Have a Dream'?
questions.explanation: Yeh aitihasik bhashan 28 August 1963 ko March on Washington ke dauran diya gaya tha.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: Who were languishing in the corners of American society and felt like exiles in their own land?
questions.explanation: Mukti ghoshna ke 100 saal baad bhi ashwet log (Negroes) samaj ke kono mein upekshit jeevan jee rahe the.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: America had given the Negro citizens a .......... which came back marked 'insufficient funds'.
questions.explanation: King kehte hain ki America ne ashweton ko ek 'bad cheque' diya hai jo aparyaapt dhan ke thappe ke sath wapas aa gaya.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: Who is popularly known as the 'Black Gandhi'?
questions.explanation: Gandhiji ke ahinsak siddhanton par chalne ke kaaran Martin Luther King, Jr. ko 'Black Gandhi' kaha jata hai.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: The social and economic condition of the Negroes in America was ..........
questions.explanation: Kavi ashweton ki dainiya sthiti ko 'appalling' (atyant shochneeya aur bhayanak) batate hain.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: Martin Luther King, Jr. consistently advocated .......... struggle.
questions.explanation: Unhone hamesha ahinsak sangharsh (non-violent struggle) aur shanti ka marg apnane par zor diya.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: Martin Luther King, Jr. wanted justice to roll down like ..........
questions.explanation: Bhashan mein kaha gaya hai: 'until justice rolls down like waters and righteousness like a mighty stream'.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: Martin Luther King, Jr. was a great orator and a renowned .......... of America.
questions.explanation: Weh America ke ek mahan vakta aur nagrik adhikaar karyakarta (civil rights activist) the.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: The governor of which state had lips dripping with the words of interposition and nullification?
questions.explanation: Bhashan mein Alabama ke governor ki nasliya kattarta ka zikr kiya gaya hai.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: King dreamed that the desert state of Mississippi would transform into an .......... of freedom and justice.
questions.explanation: King ka sapna tha ki Mississippi ka registani rajya swatantrata aur nyay ke nakhlistan (oasis) mein badal jayega.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: King dreamed that his children would be judged not by the colour of their skin but by the content of their ..........
questions.explanation: Unhone sapna dekha ki unke char bachho ki pehchan unke charitra (character) ki shuddhata se hogi, twacha ke rang se nahi.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: On which date was Martin Luther King, Jr. assassinated in Memphis, Tennessee?
questions.explanation: 4 April 1968 ko Memphis ke Lorraine Motel ki balcony mein goli maarkar unki hatya kar di gayi thi.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: One hundred years after the proclamation, the Negro is still sadly crippled by the manacles of ..........
questions.explanation: Pankti hai: 'the Negro is still sadly crippled by the manacles of segregation and the chains of discrimination'.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: One hundred years later, the Negro was still .......... in the corners of American society.
questions.explanation: Kavita/bhashan ke anusaar ashwet log samaj ke kono mein narak-sa kasht jhelte huye (languishing) jeevan bita rahe the.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: The Emancipation Proclamation gave millions of Negro slaves the beacon light of ..........
questions.explanation: Is dastavez ne karodon gulam ashweton ko daasta se aazadi aur aasha ki kiran dikhayi thi.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: Martin Luther King, Jr. held which profession by training?
questions.explanation: Martin Luther King, Jr. prashikshan se ek Baptist paadri (minister) the.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: Which state of the USA was sweltering with the heat of injustice and oppression?
questions.explanation: Mississippi rajya anyay aur daman ki aag mein tap raha tha.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: King recognized that the destiny of Black Americans is tied to the destiny of their .......... brothers.
questions.explanation: Unhone kaha ki anek gora (white) bhaiyon ne mehsoos kiya hai ki unka bhagya hamare bhagya se bandha hua hai.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: 'Let freedom ring from the snow-capped Rockies of ..........'
questions.explanation: Bhashan ki pankti hai: 'Let freedom ring from the snow-capped Rockies of Colorado'.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: Martin Luther King, Jr. belonged racially to the .......... community.
questions.explanation: Weh swayam ek ashwet (Negro/African-American) the aur unhi ke adhikaaron ke neta the.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: 'Let freedom ring from the Stone Mountain of ..........'
questions.explanation: Pankti hai: 'Let freedom ring from the Stone Mountain of Georgia'.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: In which year was the Nobel Peace Prize conferred upon Martin Luther King, Jr.?
questions.explanation: Unhin saal 1964 mein pratishthit Nobel Shanti Puraskar se nawaza gaya tha.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: At the time of delivering the speech, the Negroes in America were descendants of former ..........
questions.explanation: Ashwet log un pracheen gulam daason (slaves) ke vanshaj the jinhe Africa se laya gaya tha.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: How many children did Martin Luther King, Jr. have?
questions.explanation: Bhashan mein unhone apne chaar chhote bachhon ('my four little children') ka zikr kiya tha.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: In which year was Martin Luther King, Jr. born?
questions.explanation: Martin Luther King, Jr. ka janam 15 January 1929 ko Atlanta, Georgia mein hua tha.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: Between 1955 and 1956, Martin Luther King, Jr. successfully led the famous ..........
questions.explanation: Unhone 5 December 1955 se 20 December 1956 tak chale aitihasik Montgomery Bus Boycott ka netritva kiya tha.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: Which civil rights organization did Martin Luther King, Jr. help found?
questions.explanation: Unhone dakshini isai netritva sammelan (SCLC) ki sthapna mein mukhya bhoomika nibhayi thi.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: Whose philosophy of non-violent resistance had a profound impact on Martin Luther King, Jr.?
questions.explanation: Mahatma Gandhi ke satyagrah aur ahinsa ke siddhant ne unke man aur aandolan par gahra asar dala tha.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: At which motel in Memphis, Tennessee was Martin Luther King, Jr. shot dead?
questions.explanation: Unki hatya Lorraine Motel ki balcony par khade rehne ke dauran ki gayi thi.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: Who assassinated Martin Luther King, Jr. on April 4, 1968?
questions.explanation: James Earl Ray naamak vyakti ne goli maarkar King ki hatya ki thi.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: Which book was authored by Martin Luther King, Jr. in 1958?

options.A: Stride Toward Freedom: The Montgomery Story

questions.explanation: 'Stride Toward Freedom: The Montgomery Story' unki 1958 mein aayi prasiddh pustak hai.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: Which of the following books by Martin Luther King, Jr. was published in 1964?
questions.explanation: 'Why We Can't Wait' pustak saal 1964 mein prakashit hui thi.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: How many times does the inspirational phrase 'I have a dream' appear in the speech text?
questions.explanation: Bhashan mein 'I have a dream' vakyaansh ka prayog aath (8) baar hua hai.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: On which exact date did Abraham Lincoln issue the historic Emancipation Proclamation?
questions.explanation: Rashtrapati Abraham Lincoln ne 1 January 1863 ko daso ki mukti ka aadesh lagu kiya tha.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: What does the term 'segregation' mean in the American civil rights context?

options.B: Forced separation of people based on race or skin colour

questions.explanation: 'Segregation' ka arth twacha ke rang ke aadhar par ashweton ko alag-thalag rakhna aur bhedbhav karna hota hai.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: 'Let freedom ring from Lookout Mountain of ..........'
questions.explanation: Bhashan ki pankti hai: 'Let freedom ring from Lookout Mountain of Tennessee'.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: What did King caution his followers against while demanding their rights?
questions.explanation: Unhone chetavni di ki swatantrata ki pyaas ko krodh aur hinsa ke pyaale se na bujhaya jaye.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: Which uplifting words from an old Negro spiritual song conclude the speech?

options.B: 'Free at last! Free at last! Thank God Almighty, we are free at last!'

questions.explanation: Bhashan ka ant in shabdon se hota hai: 'Free at last! Free at last! Thank God Almighty, we are free at last!'

questions.subject: english
questions.question: What would be fatal for America according to Martin Luther King, Jr.?

options.B: To overlook the urgency of the moment and underestimate the Negro's determination

questions.explanation: King ne chetavni di ki ashweton ke sankalp ko kam aankna rashtra ke liye ghatak (fatal) sidhh hoga.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: In the phrase 'manacles of segregation', which figure of speech is used?
questions.explanation: Bhedbhav ko hathkadiyon ke roop mein prastut kiya gaya hai, atah yeh roopak (Metaphor) alankar hai.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: What is the meaning of the word 'tribulations' in the phrase 'trials and tribulations'?
questions.explanation: 'Tribulations' ka matlab ghor kasht, yaatnayein aur kathinaiyan hota hai.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: The American Constitution and Declaration of Independence were described by King as a .......... note.
questions.explanation: King ne Samvidhan aur Swatantrata Ghoshna ko ek pratigya-patra (promissory note) bataya tha.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: To whom was this promissory note guaranteed according to King?

options.B: All men, black men as well as white men

questions.explanation: Yeh pratigya sabhi nagrikon ke liye thi, chahe weh gore hon ya kaale.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: What is the meaning of the word 'sweltering' in 'sweltering with the heat of oppression'?
questions.explanation: 'Sweltering' ka taatparya asahniya garmi ya tapte huye vatavaran se hai.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: King insisted that the Negro struggle must forever be conducted on the high plane of ..........
questions.explanation: Unhone nirdesh diya ki aandolan garima aur anushasan (dignity and discipline) ke uchha aadarshon par chale.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: What is the antonym of the word 'despair' as used in 'transform the jangling discords'?
questions.explanation: 'Despair' (nirasha) ka sahi vilom shabd 'Hope' (aasha) hota hai.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: Which posthumous book by Martin Luther King, Jr. was published in 1968?

options.A: Where Do We Go from Here: Chaos or Community?

questions.explanation: 'Where Do We Go from Here: Chaos or Community?' saal 1968 mein aayi unki aakhiri rachna thi.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: What is the primary theme and message of 'I Have a Dream'?

options.B: Complete racial equality, universal brotherhood, and civil justice through peaceful means
options.C: Creating a separate nation for Black people

questions.explanation: Bhashan ka mool sandesh bina hinsa ke sabhi ke liye barabari, nyay aur bhaichara sthapit karna hai.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: In which book did Martin Luther King, Jr. compile his famous sermons on love and faith in 1963?
questions.explanation: 'Strength to Love' unke aadhyaatmik aur naitik pravachanon ka 1963 ka sangrah hai.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: King envisioned that one day on the red hills of Georgia, the sons of former slaves and slave owners would ..........

options.B: sit down together at the table of brotherhood

questions.explanation: King ka sapna tha ki gulamo aur maalikoh ke bete ek sath bhaichare ki mez par baith sakein.
